How We Work

At Oklahoma Hazmat & Remediations (OHR), we provide professional handling, transportation, and disposal of both hazardous and non-hazardous waste. Our team ensures that all waste is managed responsibly, safely, and in full compliance with federal, state, and local regulations.

We carefully assess each type of waste, using specialized equipment and procedures to prevent contamination, exposure, or environmental hazards. From industrial waste to biohazards, our trained professionals manage every step of the disposal process, including proper containment, secure transportation, and safe disposal at approved facilities.

OHR’s approach minimizes risk to people, property, and the environment. Our focus is on providing efficient, reliable waste management solutions that protect the public and maintain compliance standards. Whether handling routine disposal or emergency situations, we make sure that all waste is treated, transported, and disposed of properly, giving clients peace of mind and confidence in the safety and legality of the process.
